bodyHtml:
Michael Rudden July 7, 2024

 

On Saturday, June 22nd, Guild members and guests gathered at President Cindy Mantegia’s home to celebrate the beginning of our summer season.  Over thirty folks bought potluck lunches appetizers, entrees and desserts that were enjoyed by all. Cindy provided entertainment in the form of an artist themed bingo game. Numerous tents with tables and chairs created a festive setting to catch up with returning snowbirds and meet new members. The event was enjoyed by all.
